preconditions.description: The number of boxes is between 2 and 10^5, inclusive.
The index of the box that got the last ball is between 1 and n, inclusive.
Each box contains between 0 and 10^9 balls, inclusive.
The box with index x contains at least one ball.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= output[i] <= 10^9 for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output is between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.
The sum of the initial number of balls in all boxes equals the sum of the final number of balls in all boxes.
The number of balls in the box with index x before Vasya starts acting is one less than the number of balls in that box after Vasya completes all the actions.
